newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Chemopetrol says fire won't hurt profit.
newsitem.headline: Chemopetrol says fire won't hurt profit.

text.p: Czech petrochemicals producer Chemopetrol Group a.s. said on Tuesday a recent fire at its primary supplier, the Litvinov oil refinery owned by Ceska Rafinerska a.s., will not hurt 1996 profits.

Financial director Otakar Wolf said the mid-November fire at Rafinerska's neighbouring tank station near the northern city of Litvinov halted raw materials supplies to Chemopetrol and caused a 40 percent decrease of production for one week.
"We think (the fire) will not have an influence on our results," Wolf told reporters. "The supplies (from Ceska Rafinerska) were renewed two to three days before our reserves emptied."
Wolf added that total damage caused by the fire would be calculated after the closure of December accounting.
Chemopetrol has forecast 1.6 billion crowns in gross profit for 1996 after 3.93 billion in 1995, the last year before Chemopetrol's refining operations were folded into Ceska Rafinerska.
